verdict.rationale: The product ships on multiple distribution channels. It was accepted into Claude Code's official marketplace, has marketplace installs for Codex and Copilot, and has an `npx skills add` installer that writes editable skill files into the project repo, where they can be committed. A runtime probe confirmed a real install into ./.claude/skills/. missing for 10: explicit documentation of team-wide rollout (e.g., committing installed skills or project-level plugin config so every teammate gets the same pinned set).

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can distribute a standard skill set to my whole team — via a marketplace, a shared repo, or files committed to the project

citations.quote: `mattpocock-skills` was accepted into **Claude Code's official marketplace**... `claude plugins install mattpocock-skills` is now the documented route
codex plugin marketplace add mattpocock/skills codex plugin add mattpocock-skills@mattpocock ... Updates itself at startup.
It writes the skills into your repo as ordinary files you own and can edit.
selectively installed the single `tdd` skill to ./.claude/skills/tdd/
